newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bridge to decide action July 22.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bridge to decide action July 22.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp said on Monday its board of directors will meet July 22 to decide on the strategic alternatives available to the company to enhance stockholder value.

The company said its adviser, Legg Mason, has received a "substantial number of inquiries regarding the company" since the announcement on June 18 of its decision to review the company's strategic alternatives.
Dominion Bridge said it will announce the actions decided on at the meeting at the close of trading July 22.
The company said members of the committee to revitalize Dominion Bridge met with Legg Mason on July 2 to present their proposal, which will be considered along with other alternatives.

"Legg Mason has indicated that it is following an accelerated schedule to review a number of proposals by serious parties and will review the committee's proposal, all with the objective to deliver shareholder value through recommendation to the board of directors," the company said in a statement.
Dominion Bridge also said it will hold an informational meeting for shareholders on July 16 at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT at the Harvard Club in New York City.
